The Mukhyamantri Vigyan Pratibha Parikshais conducted annually by The
Directorate of Education, GNCT of Delhi, for students studying in Class-IXth. It is meant to
identify and nurture the talented students studying in class IXth.

Scholarship is awarded to the meritorious candidates whose merit is within top 1000 rank
(Category wise). They are eligible for one-time scholarship of Rs.5000/- and a merit
certificate.

The Exam will be conducted at various centers in DOE schools of Delhi on 21/11/2026
(Saturday) [Tentative].

(i) The students presently studying in Class IX in Govt., Govt. Aided, Unaided recognized
Pvt. Schools including the Kendriya Vidyalaya, Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalaya, School of
NDMC, DCB, etc. in GNCT of Delhi.

(ii) The Students who have secured minimum 60% marks in class VIII for General and OBC
category and 55% marks for the reserved categories (SC/ST/PH) in the session 2025-26.

15% of the students belonging to the SC Category, 7.5% for students belonging to the ST
category and 27% for students belonging to OBC category (Non-creamy layer) as per
Government of NCT Delhi Revenue Department, 10% for Economically Weaker Section
(EWS) those who have not covered under the reservation scheme for SC/ST/OBC, 4%(within
category) for children with benchmark disabilities, of which, one percent each shall be
reserved for persons with bench mark Disabilities under clauses (a), (b) and (c) and one per
cent for persons with benchmark disabilities under clauses (d) and (e) namely :-
(a) Blindness and low vision; (Visually impaired low vision)
(b) Deaf and hard of hearing; (Hearing impaired)

(c) Locomotor disability including cerebral palsy, leprosy cured, dwarfism, acid attack
victims and muscular dystrophy; (LD)
(d) Autism, intellectual disability, specific learning disability and mental illness; (AID)

(e) Multiple disabilities from amongst persons under clauses (a) to (d) including deaf-
blindness in the posts identified for each disabilities (MD)
